checks.requirement: All four campaign SKUs are on the eye-level middle shelf with at least two facings each.
checks.question: Check the middle shelf for at least two facings each of blue Original Roast, orange Hazelnut, black Dark Roast and green Decaf.
checks.compliant: All four SKUs are on the middle shelf, each with at least two facings.
checks.not_compliant: A listed SKU is missing, is on another shelf, or has fewer than two facings.

checks.requirement: The range runs left to right: Original Roast, Hazelnut, Dark Roast, Decaf.
checks.question: Check the left-to-right order of the four SKUs, including whether Hazelnut is immediately right of Original Roast.
checks.compliant: The order is Original Roast, Hazelnut, Dark Roast, Decaf, with Hazelnut immediately beside Original Roast.
checks.not_compliant: The SKUs are in a different order or Hazelnut is not immediately right of Original Roast.

checks.requirement: Brightmoor products form one block on the middle shelf, with no unlisted Brightmoor products elsewhere in the fixture.
checks.question: Check that all Brightmoor packs are together in one middle-shelf block and are limited to the four campaign SKUs.
checks.compliant: All Brightmoor packs are together in one middle-shelf block; no unlisted Brightmoor SKU or separate Brightmoor group is displayed.
checks.not_compliant: Brightmoor packs are split into separate groups or shelves, or an unlisted Brightmoor SKU is displayed.

checks.requirement: The Brightmoor block has no product-width empty gaps, including an empty Hazelnut facing.
checks.question: Look for spaces at least one pack wide within the Brightmoor block where the shelf base or back is visible, particularly among the Hazelnut facings.
checks.compliant: There are no product-width empty spaces within the block or among the Hazelnut facings.
checks.not_compliant: A product-width empty space is visible within the block or a Hazelnut facing is empty.

checks.requirement: No other brand's products sit inside or between Brightmoor packs.
checks.question: Check whether another brand's products interrupt the Brightmoor block.
checks.compliant: No other brand's products are inside or between Brightmoor packs; competitor products beside the block are acceptable.
checks.not_compliant: A product from another brand sits inside or between Brightmoor packs.

checks.requirement: Displayed packs are forward, upright and front-facing.
checks.question: Check whether displayed packs are pulled to the front shelf edge and stand upright with their front labels facing shoppers. Consider only the Brightmoor packs and their shelf; ignore other brands and the jars.
checks.compliant: Packs are forward, upright and front-facing.
checks.not_compliant: A pack is set back, fallen, on its side, upside down or turned with its side panel facing out.

checks.requirement: No visibly damaged packs remain on display.
checks.question: Look for crushed, torn, opened or otherwise visibly damaged packs on display. Consider only the Brightmoor packs and their shelf; ignore other brands and the jars.
checks.compliant: Displayed packs have no visible damage.
checks.not_compliant: A crushed, torn, opened or otherwise visibly damaged pack is on display.

checks.requirement: The shelf is free of litter, spillage and loose packaging.
checks.question: Look for litter, spillage or loose packaging on the Brightmoor shelf. Consider only the Brightmoor packs and their shelf; ignore other brands and the jars.
checks.compliant: The shelf is free of litter, spillage and loose packaging.
checks.not_compliant: Litter, spillage or loose packaging is visible on the shelf.

checks.requirement: Original Roast has a visible white £4.00 shelf-edge label directly below it; its former £3.50 label is absent.
checks.question: Read the label below Original Roast and check for any remaining Original Roast £3.50 label.
checks.compliant: A fully visible white Original Roast £4.00 label is directly below its facings, with no Original Roast £3.50 label remaining.
checks.not_compliant: The label is missing, misplaced, covered, not white, or does not read £4.00, or an Original Roast £3.50 label remains.

checks.requirement: Hazelnut has a visible yellow £3.00 introductory-price shelf-edge label directly below it.
checks.question: Read the shelf-edge label directly below the Hazelnut facings and check its colour.
checks.compliant: A fully visible yellow Hazelnut £3.00 label is directly below its facings.
checks.not_compliant: The Hazelnut label is missing, misplaced, covered, not yellow or does not read £3.00.

checks.requirement: Dark Roast has a visible white £4.00 shelf-edge label directly below it.
checks.question: Read the shelf-edge label directly below the Dark Roast facings and check its colour.
checks.compliant: A fully visible white Dark Roast £4.00 label is directly below its facings.
checks.not_compliant: The Dark Roast label is missing, misplaced, covered, not white or does not read £4.00.

checks.requirement: Decaf has a visible white £4.00 shelf-edge label directly below it.
checks.question: Read the shelf-edge label directly below the Decaf facings and check its colour.
checks.compliant: A fully visible white Decaf £4.00 label is directly below its facings.
checks.not_compliant: The Decaf label is missing, misplaced, covered, not white or does not read £4.00.

checks.requirement: One “NEW” shelf strip runs along the shelf edge beneath the Hazelnut facings.
checks.question: Check for one shelf strip reading “NEW” beneath the Hazelnut facings.
checks.compliant: One “NEW” shelf strip is positioned beneath the Hazelnut facings.
checks.not_compliant: The strip is absent, does not read “NEW”, is not beneath Hazelnut, or is duplicated.

checks.requirement: No Summer Saver material or other unlisted Brightmoor point-of-sale material remains.
checks.question: Look for Summer Saver material, including its wobbler, or any Brightmoor point-of-sale material other than the specified “NEW” shelf strip.
checks.compliant: No Summer Saver material or other unlisted Brightmoor point-of-sale material is displayed.
checks.not_compliant: A Summer Saver item or another unlisted Brightmoor point-of-sale item is displayed.

checks.requirement: No shelf level has more than two wobblers.
checks.question: Count the Brightmoor wobblers on each shelf level. Other brands' material is not part of this check.
checks.compliant: Each shelf level has no more than two wobblers.
checks.not_compliant: A shelf level has three or more wobblers.

checks.requirement: Brightmoor point-of-sale material does not hide a Brightmoor product name or shelf-edge price.
checks.question: Check whether Brightmoor point-of-sale material hides a Brightmoor product or price. Covering means hiding a Brightmoor product's name or a Brightmoor shelf-edge price. A wobbler hanging over the shelf below, or material touching a pack's edge, is not covering. Other brands' material is not part of this check.
checks.compliant: Every Brightmoor product name and shelf-edge price remains visible.
checks.not_compliant: Brightmoor point-of-sale material hides a Brightmoor product name or shelf-edge price.

not_checkable.requirement: Rotate stock so the shortest-dated packs are at the front.
Confirm till prices by test purchase.

not_checkable.rule: Brief: Campaign period; Display set-up deadline
not_checkable.requirement: Set up the display before opening on 29 June 2027 and run it during the campaign period.
Check the block every two hours and record replenishment on the launch checklist.
Invoice the launch listing fee, conduct audits within three days and in week four, and review rate of sale after six weeks.

not_checkable.rule: Standards 6.1–6.2; Brief: Commercial terms and reporting
not_checkable.requirement: Upload the required audit photographs and retake unusable photographs.
Have the store manager sign the visit report before the rep leaves.
